ns2:course.label: Advances in Vet Internal Med
ns2:course.description: A series of lectures, seminars, and discussions devoted to intense study of new pathophysiologic aspects of selected topics in veterinary internal medicine. Each term is devoted to three topics. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Graduate Veterinarian and consent of instructor.
